mapper.select: SELECT p.context_epoch,p.bundle_hash,p.ledger_watermark::text ledger_watermark,p.source_manifest_sha256, p.summary,p.summary_sha256,p.input_estimated_tokens,p.policy_version,p.created_at FROM pf.task_context_projection_current c JOIN pf.task_context_projection p ON p.space_id=c.space_id AND p.task_id=c.task_id AND p.context_epoch=c.context_epoch WHERE c.space_id=#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND c.task_id=#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT p.context_epoch,p.bundle_hash,p.ledger_watermark::text ledger_watermark,p.source_manifest_sha256, p.summary,p.summary_sha256,p.input_estimated_tokens,p.policy_version,p.created_at FROM pf.task t JOIN pf.membership m ON m.space_id=t.space_id AND m.user_id=t.creator_id JOIN pf.task_context_projection_current c ON c.space_id=t.space_id AND c.task_id=t.id JOIN pf.task_context_projection p ON p.space_id=c.space_id AND p.task_id=c.task_id AND p.context_epoch=c.context_epoch WHERE t.id=#{task,jdbcType=OTHER} AND t.creator_id=#{actor.userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND t.space_id=#{actor.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.status='ACTIVE'
SELECT context_epoch FROM pf.task_context_projection_current WHERE space_id=#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND task_id=#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.task_context_projection_current(space_id,task_id,context_epoch) VALUES(#{lease.spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{lease.taskId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{epoch}) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET context_epoch=EXCLUDED.context_epoch,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE pf.task_context_projection_current.space_id=EXCLUDED.space_id AND pf.task_context_projection_current.context_epoch=#{expected}
